title: Decentralized Inexact Cubic Newton Method with Consensus Procedure
summary: Distributed optimization is widely used in large-scale and privacy-preserving machine learning, where each agent stores a local objective and communicates only with its neighbors in a connected network. We study decentralized second-order optimization and focus on consensus procedures that approximately average local iterates, gradients, and Hessians through neighbor-to-neighbor communications.
